inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Stock per warehouse and service van, reservations against work orders, and purchase suggestions when an item reaches its reorder point.

feedback.error: The action could not be completed. Check stock, access, and that the work order is open.

suggestions.title: Purchase suggestions
suggestions.description: Items at or below the reorder point, after active reservations.
suggestions.empty: No items need restocking right now.

items.title: Items
items.empty: No items have been registered yet.

locations.title: Locations
locations.empty: No warehouses or vans have been registered yet.
locations.name: Warehouse or van name

stock.noLevels: No stock has been registered for this item yet.

adjust.title: Adjust stock
adjust.description: In and out reject negative stock. Adjustment is an explicit correction and can fix a count.

reserve.title: Reserve parts
reserve.description: The reservation holds available quantity against a work order or work session. Stock is deducted only when consumed.

workOrderParts.title: Spare parts
workOrderParts.consumeVisit: Consume parts for a completed session
workOrderParts.consumeVisitDescription: Consumes all active reservations tied to the session. Use this when the work has actually been done.
